questions.question: Sindhu Darshan festival is celebrated in which part of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

• **Sindhu Darshan festival** is celebrated in **Ladakh**.

 
 
• This festival is held every year on the banks of the **Indus River**, also known as the Sindhu River, which is one of the longest rivers in Asia.
 
• The festival is a celebration of the river Sindhu, which is considered a symbol of India's identity and civilization.
 
• It aims to promote the cultural heritage and communal harmony of the region.
 
• The festival includes traditional music, dance performances, and rituals performed by Buddhist monks.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Sindhu Darshan festival was first started in the year **1997**.
 
• The festival is usually celebrated in the month of **June** every year.
 
• It attracts tourists from all over the country and abroad, fostering tourism in the Ladakh region.
 
• Ladakh, known for its stunning landscapes and rich culture, becomes a hub of activities during this festival.
 
• The festival also highlights the importance of river Sindhu in historical and cultural contexts, emphasizing its role in the sustenance of the civilizations along its banks.

questions.question: The phloem is the plant's vascular tissue that transports ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**nutrients.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **phloem** is the plant’s **vascular tissue** that transports** ****nutrients**, primarily sugars (such as sucrose) produced during** ****photosynthesis**, from the leaves to other parts of the plant.
 
• **Function**: The phloem is responsible for **transporting nutrients** (especially sugars) throughout the plant.
 
• **Direction**: It moves nutrients **from the leaves** (where they are produced) to other parts of the plant.
 
• **Components**: The phloem consists of **sieve tubes**, which are elongated cells, and **companion cells** that support their function.
 
• **Translocation**: Nutrient movement through the phloem occurs via a process called **translocation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Bidirectional Movement**: Phloem allows **bidirectional movement** of nutrients. Sugars move from the **source** (usually leaves) to the **sink tissues** (roots, stems, flowers, fruits) for growth and other processes.
 
• **Structure**:
 
 
• Sieve elements lack a nucleus at maturity and maximize space for translocation.
 
• Sieve plates have pores and play a crucial role in nutrient exchange.
 
• **Pressure Flow Hypothesis**: The **pressure flow hypothesis** explains how sugars move through the phloem using osmotic pressure gradients.
 
 

 ​**Applications****:**

 
• **Textiles**: Bast fibers (derived from phloem) contribute to high-quality textiles.
 
• **Ropes and Yarn**: Their tensile strength makes them ideal for making ropes and yarn.
 
• **Paper Production**: Bast fibers play a role in papermaking.

questions.question: The total surface area of a cylinder of radius 70 m and height 140 m, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) of the cylinder = 70 m

Height (h) of the cylinder = 140 m

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

**Calculation:**

Substitute the values of r and h into the formula:

Total Surface Area = 2π × 70 × (140 + 70)

Total Surface Area = 2π × 70 × 210

Total Surface Area = 2 × 22/7 × 70 × 210

Total Surface Area = 2 × 220 × 210

Total Surface Area = 440 × 210

Total Surface Area = 92,400 m²

**The total surface area of the cylinder is 92,400 m².**

questions.question: Which of the following elements shows maximum valence electrons?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__option(1).__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Valence electrons are **electrons in the outermost shell (energy level)** of an atom.

 
 
• According to this **fluorine **has 7 electrons in its outermost shell.
 
• These electrons can **participate in the formation of chemical bonds** if the outermost shell is not closed.
 
• In a **single covalent bond**, both atoms contribute one valence electron to form a shared pair.
 
• The presence of valence electrons determines an element’s **chemical properties**, including its **valency** (how readily it bonds with other elements) and the number of bonds it can form.
 
• An atom with a **closed shell of valence electrons**, corresponding to a **noble gas configuration**, tends to be **chemically inert**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Valence electrons are crucial for understanding **bonding**, **molecular geometry**, and **chemical reactions**.
 
• They determine whether an element forms **ionic bonds**, **covalent bonds**, or participates in **metallic bonding**.
 
• Elements in the same group (column) of the periodic table have similar valence electron configurations and exhibit similar chemical behavior.
 
• Valence electrons impact material properties, such as electrical conductivity and hardness.
 
• Understanding valence electrons helps predict chemical reactions and design new materials.

• **Deposition** occurs when the transported materials are eventually laid down or deposited, often in new locations such as river deltas, beaches, or sand dunes.
 
• The combined effect of these processes leads to the gradual leveling of the Earth's surface, contributing to the dynamic nature of the planet's topography.

15x + 25y = 405

15x + 9y = 213

15x + 25y - (15x + 9y) = 405 - 213

16y = 192

Solve for y:

y = (192)/(16)

y = 12

Substitute y = 12 into the first equation:

3x + 5(12) = 81

3x + 60 = 81

3x = 21

x = (21)/(3)

x = 7

Cost of 1 pencil and 2 pens together:

1x + 2y = 7 + 2(12)

1x + 2y = 7 + 24

1x + 2y = 31

**The cost of 1 pencil and 2 pens together is ₹31.**

Mg(OH)₂ + 2HCl → MgCl₂ + 2H₂O
questions.solution:

__
 
• The reaction between magnesium hydroxide (Mg(OH)2) and hydrochloric acid (HCl) is a **neutralisation reaction**.

 
 
• In a neutralisation reaction, an acid reacts with a base to form a salt and water.
 
• Here, Mg(OH)2, a base, reacts with HCl, an acid, to form MgCl2 (a salt) and H2O (water).
 
• This type of reaction is important in various applications, including antacid formulations and industrial processes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **decomposition reaction** involves breaking down a single compound into two or more simpler substances, which is not the case here.
 
• A **combination reaction** involves two or more substances combining to form a single product, which is also not applicable here.
 
• A **precipitation reaction** involves the formation of an insoluble solid (precipitate) from a solution, which does not occur in this reaction.
 
• Neutralisation reactions are a subset of double displacement reactions where the reactants exchange ions to form water and a salt.

questions.question: A starts from X at 9:00 a.m. and reaches Y at 1:00 p.m. on the same day, B also starts from Y at 9:00 a.m. and reaches X at 3 p.m on the same day, following the same route as A. At what time do the two meet?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A starts from X at 9:00 a.m. and reaches Y at 1:00 p.m.

B starts from Y at 9:00 a.m. and reaches X at 3:00 p.m.

They follow the same route.

**Formula Used:**

Meeting point time = (Product of times taken by A and B) / (Sum of times taken by A and B)

**Calculation:**

Time taken by A = 1:00 p.m. - 9:00 a.m. = 4 hours

Time taken by B = 3:00 p.m. - 9:00 a.m. = 6 hours

Let the time after 9:00 a.m. when they meet be t hours.

Relative speed of A and B = Distance / 4 hrs + Distance / 6 hrs

Distance = Relative speed × t

Relative speed = Distance / 4 + Distance / 6

Relative speed = Distance (1/4 + 1/6)

Relative speed = Distance (3/12 + 2/12)

Relative speed = Distance (5/12) ......(I)

We know that,

Distance = Relative speed × t

Putting the value of relative speed in above equation

Distance = Distance (5/12) × t

t = 12/5 = 2.4 hours = 2 hours 24 minutes

Time when they meet = 9:00 a.m. + 2 hour 24 minutes

Time when they meet = 11:24 a.m.

**Therefore, A and B meet at 11:24 a.m.**
